notes.title: FLY GUYS is Successfully Funded!!! + Demo Update #3
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44635082/b2350e4938c53242b227e1c8a0c576467c5bf1e1.png

Thank you, FLY GUYS backers and supporters!!! 🦉🥚 

From the bottom of all of our hearts, thank you so much for helping FLY GUYS take flight!

On January 17th, our Kickstarter became fully funded!!! We have reached over 20,000$ to help take FLY GUYS to new heights, and our team could not feel more appreciative. Thank you to all the wonderful fly guys, gals, and pals that helped make this possible! We appreciate all the backers, people who helped spread the good word, and anyone else who contributed to make this game a reality! 

As we head off to the last few days of the campaign, we are still going, so let's finish off strong!

When the campaign ends on January 29th, make sure you are ready! We are going to be sending out a Backer Survey in order to get all the important information we need in order to ship out the physical and digital rewards. The delivery time of many of these rewards will be given out closer to the launch of the game. However, for Custom Pal, Crow Pal, and Seagull Pals, they will be given the link to the developer Discords and communication for custom bird characters.

Updates
Join the official FLY GUYS fan Discord server! People who are backers will get a special role! -> https://discord.gg/MnERCZp5KT

FLY GUYS Demo is now updated! 
Yesterday, the FLY GUYS demo is now updated! Please update and give the demo another go whenever you can, we have improved and tweaked so many things to make FLY GUYS more fun and enjoyable for everyone! 

Future updates on the game will be posted on our social media accounts, and on our fan Discord server! 

Future updates on the physical and digital rewards from our Kickstarter will continue to be on our Kickstarter page here.

To reiterate, we would like to thank everyone to help make FLY GUYS the best that it can be. This has become a dream come true for all of us, and we hope you enjoy the hype train of development with us!

With that, have a wonderful rest of your day!

-The FLY GUYS Team

notes.title: FLY GUYS Demo Update #2 + Holiday 2024 Crowdfunding Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hello Fly Guys, Gals, and Pals!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44635082/b4a7e862f36455bd657bb7a4cc4dab804aa20de3.jpg

We updated the FLY GUYS demo just today. The update includes many improvements to overall controls and game feel, and we hope you can try it out and see the improvement! 

Some improvements include:

 Overall improvements to both flying and on-ground controls.
 Addition of a fruit-pushing challenge! Make your way up to the top of the village's spire while rolling a fruit to the top!
 Updated VFX for the water.
 New dash mechanic! Now you can soar through the skies or trot through the world at record speed! Speedrunners, take note!
 The ability to turn on or off the game's post-processing and fine-tune it to your liking!
 Many other bug fixes and improvements.


Crowdfunding Announcement!
Towards the end of 2024, the FLY GUYS team is planning to launch a crowdfunding campaign. Most likely on either Kickstarter or Indiegogo.

This funding will allow us to:

 Release FLY GUYS on consoles(PlayStation, XBOX, Nintendo Switch)
 Fund future convention booths to show off the game!
 Fund further development.
 Marketing with online content creators!

 
With this crowdfunding, backers will be able to get some cool FLY GUYS-related items and merchandise! Further details will be elaborated on soon, so keep your eyes peeled!

Fly high our wonderful friends!

-The FLY GUYS Team

notes.title: FLY GUYS DEMO UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hello Fly Guys, Gals, and Pals!

Here's a look at what you can look forward to in the full game and in the demo

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44635082/daf4ab5870dae638284c5701752553f98372d8d3.png
The Phoenix Jungle

In the last large update we shared that we were working on a new island called the Phoenix Jungle. It is now very full of life and energy! You’ll find that the Fly Guys and Gals on this island love living life and taking in the sun.

New and Improved Systems

The team has been working hard on some improvements to the game that aren’t as large scale as the jungle island - but we’re sure they’ll make a world of difference! Here’s a highlight of some special things the team has been up to.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44635082/c2d1d37817fef4f4ff7cc2335b203a2a57a6641c.gif
Forecast Shows Light Snow in the Frostbelly Archipelago

Our VFX artist has been hard at work creating this cool snowy effect that only appears when Fly Guy enters Frostbelly Archipelago. Make sure to bundle up!

Rounding Out The Edges

Our team has been continuously polishing the game’s feel and appearance; One of these polishes includes this panini projection effect which makes the world look round! It also reminds us of the CRT days of gaming.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44635082/585bd9292540dc068adb07641f54086a374e2abd.gif
More Game Settings

Our Lead Engineer has been improving and expanding the game settings available to the player. We hope that this expansion will improve the experience for all players to enjoy the game however they like!

We hope you're jazzed about these updates - there's more to come!
